question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is: **nothing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"nothing"** means not anything; no single thing. (कुछ नहीं)
 
• **"Nothing" **is used to indicate the absence of anything, whereas other options imply the presence of something. (कुछ नहीं)
 
 
• **Example: **He has nothing to say about the situation.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that of all the things on earth, health is the most precious. The others have no value without it.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is **'nothing'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **nothing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **it** (यह): Refers to a thing previously mentioned or easily identified.

 
 
• **Example:** I found the book, it was on the table.
 
 
 
• **everything** (सबकुछ): All things; all the things of a group or class.
 
 
• **Example:** She packed everything she needed for the trip.
 
 
 
• **all** (सब): Used to refer to the whole quantity or extent of a particular group or thing.
 
 
• **Example:** All the students passed the exam.
